name: Automated Report Email with Charts Data

parameters.content:
## Automated Report Email with Charts Data

Weekly automated report with summary statistics.

**Flow:**
1. Weekly schedule (Monday 8 AM)
2. Read data from Google Sheets
3. Code generates summary stats and HTML tables
4. Gmail sends formatted HTML report
5. Log send event to Sheets

**Setup:**
- Connect Gmail and Google Sheets credentials
- Set data source spreadsheet ID
- Set report recipient email
- Set send log spreadsheet
